title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the direct metadata save refuses an object without its package namespace prefix
body:
Fixes #24547
Clause-②: no (narrowing) (the active save door newly refuses an object whose name lacks its package's namespace prefix, which today it makes live; a narrowing owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue)

Ruling-ref: 6278955141 (the maintainer: 「同意」 — pull forward into 18.0 as a refusal). Surface amendment: 6280587888 (the per-item publish door: same rule, same code, same judge).

## What changes

ADR-0129 D2: a package declares its prefix once (`manifest.namespace`), and every object it defines is named `namespace_shortName`. The package draft publish (`publishPackageDrafts`) refused an unprefixed object draft with `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`. The direct (publish-mode) `saveMetaItem` and the per-item publish (`publishMetaItem`) made the very same name `active` under the very same package. Now all three doors ask one judge and give one answer.

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`
  - New private `objectNamespacePrefixViolation(name, packageId)`. It reads the package's declared namespace from the installed manifest and returns `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`'s own sentence, or `null`. A package with no namespace, and a write bound to no package, are not judged.
  - `publishPackageDrafts`' pre-flight now calls that judge. This is a pure refactor: same namespace read, same verdict, same code.
  - `saveMetaItem` asks the same judge for an `object` in publish mode. It is judged against the package the save writes: the one it names, or the one a package-less publish save resolved into. On a violation it throws `code: 'NAMESPACE_PREFIX'`, `status: 422`, with the verbatim prescription.
    - Position: after the ADR-0029 D9.9 refusal, and before the protection/lock gates and the body parse.
    - Not asked of draft saves: the door that promotes the draft judges it, the publish pre-flight batch-atomically and the per-item publish before its promotion writes.
    - Not asked of the server-stated rewrites of stored rows (`source` set: `migrate-stored`, the flow-credential move).
    - The package copies (`package-duplicate`, `package-unmanaged-import`) are asked, like any author.
  - `promoteDraftForPublish`, the per-item publish's promotion, asks the same judge for an `object` draft on `promoteInto`, the package the active row is written under. On a violation it throws the same `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` / 422 with the same sentence, before `repo.promoteDraft` writes, so nothing is promoted and the draft stays a draft. The exemptions are the same: no package, no namespace, `sys_*`, and sealed managed content (as for the D9.9 refusal beside it). `publishPackageDrafts` also promotes through here, but its pre-flight refuses the same name first.
  - A comment in `duplicatePackage` that called the direct save "a door no prefix gate reads" is corrected.
- No new error code. `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` is already registered to `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`), and the publish pre-flight already stamps it. No ADR edit and no `packages/spec` change.
- Changeset: `.changeset/24547-active-save-namespace-prefix.md`. It is `minor` and **BREAKING**, has FROM / TO / Fix lines covering both doors (the direct save and the per-item publish), the `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` line and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check:adr-0087-registration` accepts that disposition.

## Measured on the wire (fresh showcase on this branch, after the fix: the table at `3b94654c58`; the per-item rows, and a re-read of the direct PUT and publish-drafts with the same answers, at `afb7f17447`)

| request | answer |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/packages` `com.v1.rollup` | 201 (namespace derived: `rollup`) |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report?package=com.v1.rollup` | **422** `{"error":"Object 'v1_report' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'rollup_v1_report' (namespace = 'rollup').","code":"NAMESPACE_PREFIX"}`; `GET /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report` then 404 |
| same door, missing `sharingModel` (sibling refusal, for the envelope) | 422 `{"error":"object/rollup_no_owd failed author-time validation: …","code":"INVALID_METADATA","issues":[…]}` |
| `PUT …/meta/object/rollup_v1_report?package=com.v1.rollup` (prefixed) | 200 `state: active` |
| `PUT …/meta/object/v1_loose` (no package) | 200 `state: active` |
| `PUT …/meta/object/v1_report?package=com.v1.rollup&mode=draft` | 200 `state: draft` (unchanged) |
| `POST /api/v1/packages/com.v1.rollup/publish-drafts` | 200 `outcome: refused`, `failed[0].code: NAMESPACE_PREFIX`, the same sentence (unchanged) |
| `POST /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report/publish?package=com.v1.rollup` (per-item publish of that draft) | **422** `{"error":"Object 'v1_report' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'rollup_v1_report' (namespace = 'rollup').","code":"NAMESPACE_PREFIX"}`. Then `GET /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report` 404 and `POST /api/v1/data/v1_report` 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, and a following publish-drafts still lists the draft in `failed[]` |
| prefixed draft `rollup_v1_report`, then `POST …/meta/object/rollup_v1_report/publish?package=com.v1.rollup` | 200, then `GET` 200 |

The `/meta` PUT door answers in the flat REST dialect, so the code is top-level `code`, beside `error`. That is the same place the door puts `INVALID_METADATA`.

## Pins (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.active-save-namespace-prefix.test.ts`, 8 cases)

1. An unprefixed object under a namespaced package is refused. The pin asserts `code: NAMESPACE_PREFIX` and `status: 422` (the envelope, not a bare throw), the first sentence, the rename, and that no row is written.
2. The prefixed name saves `active`.
3. Control: a package that declares no namespace saves the unprefixed name.
4. Control: a save naming no package saves the unprefixed name.
5. A package-less publish save that resolves into the namespaced package (its active row is bound there) is refused, and the stored row is untouched.
6. A draft save is unchanged. `publishPackageDrafts` refuses it with `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`, and `publishMetaItem` refuses it too. `failed[0].error` and the per-item refusal's message both equal the active door's message byte for byte, and the draft is still the only row.
7. The per-item publish of an unprefixed object draft under a namespaced package is refused. The pin asserts `code: NAMESPACE_PREFIX` and `status: 422`, the first sentence and the rename. Nothing is promoted and the draft stays a draft.
8. Control: the per-item publish promotes a prefixed object draft under the same package.

Reproduced first, on the unfixed code: cases 1, 5 and 6 red (the active save answered `saved`), cases 2–4 green.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on the committed fix): `if (prefixViolation) {` was changed to `if (false && prefixViolation) {`. The anchor went 1 → 0 and the blob 72a5cff9503e → 88f5360fcedf. Cases 1, 5 and 6 went red and 2–4 stayed green. Restore was proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The direction was red, as expected. No dist build was needed: the suite imports `./protocol.js` from source.

Second ablation, the per-item publish branch, on the committed fix `afb7f17447`.
- Declared direction, before running: red on exactly cases 6 and 7, green on the other six.
- `const prefixViolation = this.objectNamespacePrefixViolation(request.name, promoteInto);` was changed to `const prefixViolation = false && this.objectNamespacePrefixViolation(request.name, promoteInto);`. The anchor went 1 → 0 and the blob aecdeed0e1a2 → b1797c55d012.
- Result: '2 failed | 6 passed', exactly cases 6 and 7.
- Restore was proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Verification on the final head `afb7f17447` (the per-item publish fix, on top of a merge of `origin/main` `d1173825b7` through `os-regen-merge.sh`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: 251 files passed (3 skipped), 20798 tests passed.
- objectql, the whole suite on the fixed dist: 449 files and 8452 tests, all passed. In round 0, before the fixture change, its only 14 failures were the three adjusted files, each failing on the new refusal.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` OK, ledger unchanged).
- Derived gate union (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 78 commands, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 78 derived, 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the fresh worktree had no full build yet). Re-run after the build: exit 0.
- Dogfood, run once on `3b94654c58` (not re-run in this round), on the files that write objects under a package: `package-first-authoring`, `flow-shipped-name-published-door` and `install-local-unmanaged-mode` all passed. `wall-environment-metadata-refusal` had 2 failures, unrelated to this diff; see Acceptance notes.
- Not run locally, left to CI: `test:repo`, which this diff does not touch, and the consumer packages' own suites outside the measured set below.

## File surface beyond the claim (declared)

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-duplicate-package-{unprefixed-object,names-in-step,permission-field-keys}.test.ts`. These ADR-0070 D4 duplicate fixtures staged an unprefixed object under a namespaced package through the direct save. That is the exact shape this change refuses, so without this change `Test Core` goes red. Each file now stages those objects with a `saveStoredBeforeRule` helper, which hides the package's namespace for the one save and then restores it. That models a row stored before the door read the rule, so every case keeps what it pins. No assertion changed.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the `check:engine-double-contract --write` remedy for the new suite's pinned double. It adds 3 rows and loses 0.

## Shipped-tree exposure (measured)

- Unprefixed objects saved through the direct door under a namespaced package:
  - `examples/`: 0. Code packages pass `defineStack`, and no test does a package-bound object save.
  - `packages/metadata-protocol` tests: 0. The full suite is green.
  - `packages/objectql` tests: 4 staging sites in 3 files, adjusted as above.
- Controls:
  - the runtime integration tests use `com.probe.p` / `com.probe.q`, from which `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` derives `null` (a single-letter segment);
  - the dogfood package-bound saves use unregistered bases, or `crm_`-prefixed names.

## Other doors that make an object live (enumerated; line numbers at `3b94654c58`)

- `publishMetaItem` (through `promoteDraftForPublish`; `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish`) is now judged too, per the seat's surface amendment 6280587888 on the card. At `3b94654c58` it still made the unprefixed object live: 200, then `GET` 200 and a data insert 201. At `afb7f17447` it answers 422 `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` (table above).
- Covered through `saveMetaItem`: `duplicatePackage` (`:27916`), `importUnmanagedPackage` (`:28629`), and the datasource external import (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/plugin.ts:206`, which writes no package and runs its own prefix check).
- Restore-only doors, which bring back a body that was already live: `revertCommit` (`:29484`), `rollbackToPackageCommit` (`:29975`) and `rollbackMetaItem` (`:30046`). `loadMetaFromDb` (`:31403`) hydrates stored rows at rest.
- `installPackage` registers a manifest and makes no object live.

## Acceptance notes

- ADR-0129 D2 and the `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts` header name `MetadataManager.publishPackage()` as the runtime chokepoint. That method (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:1879`) runs no object-name prefix check. The runtime doors that do are `publishPackageDrafts` and, with this change, `saveMetaItem`. No edit here, because both files are outside this card's surface. Carrier: none.
- `importUnmanagedPackage` now meets this refusal for a source package that declares no namespace and whose objects lack the prefix derived from its id. The refusal arrives mid-copy and the existing rollback undoes it, rather than at plan time. Not measured: no fixture has that shape. Carrier: none.
- Unrelated dogfood red, reproduced on this head: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/wall-environment-metadata-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, the "thirteen write doors" case, 2 failures under `isolated` and `group`. Its package publish of a `crm_lead.*` view is refused with `list-view-object-outside-closure`. That is the list-view closure refusal `origin/main` brought in, and nothing in this diff touches a view. The Dogfood Regression Gate does not run on PRs, so this surfaces on `main`'s push battery.

## For the contract-tier reviewer

- The `source !== undefined` exemption (server-stated rewrites) is deliberate. The two package-copy faces are deliberately judged.
- The refusal reads `request.packageId` after the package-less publish address resolution. Case 5 pins that.
- The per-item publish branch sits after the D9.9 refusal on `promoteInto` and before `repo.promoteDraft`, with the same sealed-managed exemption as that refusal. Case 7 and the second ablation pin it.
